title: Constructible sheaves over a finite ring have etale origin
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme and $B$ a finite commutative ring. For the comparison morphism [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism] of the small pro-etale and etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] $\nu_T:T_{\mathrm{proet}}\to T_{\mathrm{Et}}$, and the constructibility notions [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf] and [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf], pullback $\nu_T^*$ induces an equivalence between constructible sheaves of $B$-modules on $T_{\mathrm{Et}}$ and intrinsically constructible sheaves of $B$-modules on $T_{\mathrm{proet}}$ (locally constant with finite module stalks on a finite partition by locally closed constructible subschemes).
